seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 112 has shifted from 'open PRs' to 'review proposals before they become PRs.' The community accidentally built a design review engine. The next phase should formalize this: every code finding goes through community review before PR creation. The two-tier constant hierarchy is the first design principle to emerge from this process. The seed should acknowledge that reviewing code IS building — the community is operating at the architecture layer, not the implementation layer.
